cases.cutoff: before integrated quantity-production system is deployed

packet.pressure: A large public customer requires roughly six-figure annual quantities of wooden mechanical blocks. Hand manufacture is slow, variable and labor intensive. Nearby industries also struggle with inaccurate large cylinders and non-repeatable screw geometry.
availableEvidence: A newer boring arrangement supports a boring bar rigidly and can produce more accurate large cylinders than prior workpiece-guided boring.
A workshop has begun experimenting with mechanically coupled lead screws, change gears and slide rests to reproduce screw pitch more accurately.
The block product can be decomposed into repeated operations such as sawing, shaping, boring and finishing.
liveRoutes: expand skilled hand production with gauges/templates
build a small number of general-purpose machine tools and keep flexible craft routing
design a sequential set of special-purpose machines for the block workflow
constraints: precision of upstream machine tools limits downstream accuracy

cases.hiddenOutcome: An integrated sequence of specialized machines succeeds operationally and remains useful for over a century; precision-machine principles diffuse much more broadly, but the integrated line itself remains an unusual local system rather than immediately becoming a general British manufacturing model.

cases.cutoff: after disputed biological-electrical observations but before a continuous-current source is publicly demonstrated

packet.pressure: Repeated experiments show that prepared muscle tissue can contract when connected through certain conducting arrangements. The field cannot agree whether the relevant electrical cause belongs to the animal tissue itself or to contact between different conducting materials; existing static electrical sources are transient.
availableEvidence: Changing conductor combinations changes the observed contraction.
Animal tissue is a convenient detector but may also be part of the causal mechanism.
Alternating two different conductors with moist conductive material appears capable of producing repeated electrical effects.
liveRoutes: deepen experiments on intrinsic animal electricity
remove animal tissue and construct a repeated conductor/electrolyte stack
treat the controversy as underdetermined and focus on better measurement before scaling either theory
constraints: the usefulness of a continuous source beyond the original biological question is unknown

cases.hiddenOutcome: A repeated metal/electrolyte stack produces continuous current without animal tissue. Other researchers immediately use the new capability for electrolysis and later element isolation. The original dispute is not cleanly resolved into one fully correct side; bioelectricity and electrochemistry become separate productive lines.

cases.cutoff: before the first decisive long-voyage trial of the newest portable timekeeper

packet.pressure: Ocean-going ships need reliable east-west position. Dead reckoning accumulates error. Two broad technical families are viable: preserve a highly accurate reference time aboard ship, or infer position from observed celestial angular relationships and precomputed astronomical tables.
availableEvidence: Several generations of portable precision timekeepers have been built; two earlier designs exposed major flaws or failed to meet target performance, while a much smaller new design appears substantially better in workshop tests.
Astronomical observations can in principle solve the problem but require accurate instruments, tables, weather/visibility and difficult shipboard calculation.
A public reward institution offers a large prize if specified voyage accuracy can be demonstrated.
liveRoutes: fund a long-voyage test of the new timekeeper and accept it if it passes once
test the timekeeper repeatedly and require independent manufacture/reproduction before fleet reliance
invest primarily in standardized astronomical tables/instruments
continue both routes until total operating cost/reliability separates them
constraints: one-off craftsmanship may not be manufacturable
test conditions can differ from fleet use
astronomical route has high operating skill/calculation burden
institution must define what evidence is sufficient for reward/adoption

cases.hiddenOutcome: The timekeeper performs strongly on a voyage, but the evaluating institution does not treat one success as sufficient and later requires disclosure plus adequate reproductions by other makers. A parallel astronomical-table method matures and remains operationally important for decades; the best solution depends on manufacturability, cost and user conditions.

cases.cutoff: after local stratigraphic observations but before publication of a national geological map

packet.pressure: Surveyors, miners and canal builders need to correlate rock layers across distant regions. Visually similar rocks can occur in different positions/ages, and no reliable country-scale geological representation exists.
availableEvidence: Repeated canal/field sections suggest rock layers occur in a regular vertical order.
Certain fossil assemblages repeatedly co-occur with particular layers and may distinguish otherwise similar lithology.
One experienced surveyor has accumulated years of field observations but has incomplete coverage and limited finance.
A scientific society is independently collecting regional observations from many members, mine owners and local contributors for a national map.
liveRoutes: extrapolate a unified stratigraphic/fossil model from the surveyor's observations
wait for more complete direct observation before national mapping
aggregate distributed regional observations even if they lack one unifying field model
combine model-guided extrapolation with explicit uncertainty/independent regional checks
constraints: strong theory can extrapolate into unobserved areas but may be wrong
distributed contributors may be inconsistent and slower to synthesize

cases.hiddenOutcome: The field surveyor publishes first using fossil succession and a unifying stratigraphic model, creating a durable scientific method. A later society map using many regional sources is more accurate in some places because the first map sometimes extrapolated layers where they did not exist. Both model coherence and distributed observation contribute value.
